# README

- **Author**: `蔡睿燊`
- **Created At**: `2026-10-18`
- **Last Modified At**: `2026-10-18`

---

## What does this file do?

- 建立 2024 年**日曆表**（一日一列）：
  - `weekday`：上班日 = 1。週一至週五為 1，但國定假日與臺北市颱風停班停課日為 0；補班的週六為 1（組員 2026-10-18 確認）。
  - `semester`：臺大上課學期內 = 1。112-2 為 2024-02-19 至 2024-06-09，113-1 為 2024-09-02 至 2024-12-20（組員 2026-10-18 提供），其餘（寒暑假）為 0。
- 把研究範圍內 86 站的分鐘級狀態更新，彙整成**站點 × 整點**的借還流量，並合併到既有的站點 × 整點天氣 panel 與日曆：
  - 每一筆更新相對於同站前一筆的可借車數變化稱為一個「步」（step）。來源約每 2 分鐘更新一次（中位數 1.9 分鐘）。
  - **調度判定**（組員 2026-10-18 決定改用分鐘級判定，門檻由 AI 提議）：單一步的 |變化| ≥ 10 輛視為調度車補車或移車。全年單一步 |變化| 的 99.9% 分位數為 9 輛，一般騎乘在兩分鐘內很難造成 10 輛以上的變化。原本以「一小時淨變化 ≥ 25」判定的方式會把大量真實尖峰需求當成調度：這些小時中位數有 33 次更新、單步變化中位數只有 6 輛，大多數變化由許多小步累積而成。
  - 每個時段 (t − 1 小時, t] 的流量由該區間內的步加總而成；該區間的淨變化等於 t 與 t − 1 兩個整點快照的差（下方有 assertion 核對）。
- 只有 t 與 t − 1 兩個整點快照都可用（見 `data/code/youbike_weather_hourly.Rmd` 的缺值規則）時才計算流量，否則流量欄位為 `NA`。`ServiceStatus` 原樣保留並附上前一整點狀態，由下游分析決定是否排除停止營運時段。

---

## What does this file take?

- **Source Data Sets** (one entry per actual file):
  1. `data/processed/youbike_rental_in_field_2024.parquet`
     - Input key: `rental_in_field`
     - Description: 研究範圍內 86 站的 2024 年狀態更新紀錄，一列為 `StationUID` × `SrcUpdateTime`，8,112,511 列 × 11 欄。
     - Documentation: `data/processed/youbike_rental_in_field_2024_doc.Rmd`
     - SHA-256: `ef6160f4c50aa0b951419304f29a6eb572b65b6027cf027b0d2b107525981e4e`
  2. `data/processed/youbike_weather_hourly_2024.parquet`
     - Input key: `youbike_weather_hourly`
     - Description: 站點 × 整點狀態快照與臺北站天氣，86 × 8,784 = 755,424 列 × 15 欄。
     - Documentation: `data/code/youbike_weather_hourly.Rmd`（processed-data 文件待建立）
     - SHA-256: `c09ab33c7fe724c6479f4cfab3c7933403b045c64b6ecb5e8c29d1b3c52678fe`
- 國定假日、補班日與颱風假日期：依行政院人事行政總處 113 年辦公日曆表與組員確認的清單手動輸入於下方程式碼（2026-10-18）。學期日期由組員提供。

## What does this file output?

- `data/processed/calendar_2024.csv`
  - Output key: `calendar`
  - Description: 2024 年每日一列，366 列 × 5 欄：`date`、`day_of_week`（1 = 週一）、`weekday`（上班日 = 1）、`semester`（上課學期 = 1）、`day_off_reason`（非週末休假日或補班日的說明，其餘為空）。
  - Role: `analysis`（日曆共變數）
  - Documentation: 本檔
  - Expected schema and row-count rules: 366 列，`date` 不重複且連續；`weekday`、`semester` 只有 0／1。
- `data/processed/youbike_flow_hourly_2024.parquet`
  - Output key: `youbike_flow_hourly`
  - Description: 站點 × 整點 panel，保留 `youbike_weather_hourly_2024.parquet` 的全部 15 欄，再加上：
    - `prev_ServiceStatus`：t − 1 整點的營運狀態。
    - `net_flow`：t 與 t − 1 可借車數的差（輛；+ 為淨增加）。
    - `n_updates`：(t − 1, t] 內的更新筆數。
    - `rider_return`、`rider_rent`：|變化| < 10 的增加步與減少步加總（輛，皆為非負）。兩分鐘內的借與還會互相抵銷，可能低估；但部分站時的可借車數會在相鄰更新間 ±1 來回跳動（例如 2024-01-01 凌晨 `TPE500101001` 一小時 57 筆更新、還 9 借 9、淨 0），又會高估。兩者都無法分辨，**不可直接當作借還次數**，下游以 `rider_net_flow` 為主。
    - `dispatch_in`、`dispatch_out`：|變化| ≥ 10 的增加步與減少步加總（輛，皆為非負）。
    - `rider_net_flow` = `rider_return` − `rider_rent` = `net_flow` −（`dispatch_in` − `dispatch_out`）。
    - `max_step`：該小時最大的單步 |變化|（輛），供下游改用其他門檻時參考。
    - `period_date`、`hour_of_day`：時段 (t − 1, t] 起點的日期與小時；`weekday`、`semester`：依 `period_date` 合併日曆。
  - Role: `analysis`
  - Documentation: 本檔（processed-data 文件待建立）
  - Expected schema and row-count rules: 755,424 列 × 28 欄；(`StationUID`, `datetime`) 不重複；流量欄位只在兩個快照都可用時有值，此時 `net_flow` = 步的加總、`rider_net_flow` + `dispatch_in` − `dispatch_out` = `net_flow`。
  - Verification status / SHA-256: 見最後一個 chunk 的實際輸出與下方「執行結果」。
  - Downstream finding input: `finding/youbike_eda.Rmd`

All paths are relative to the project root, not the operating-system root.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)

find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(candidate, "AGENTS.md")) &&
        dir.exists(file.path(candidate, "templates"))) return(candidate)
    parent <- dirname(candidate)
    if (identical(parent, candidate)) stop("Open this notebook within the student project containing AGENTS.md and templates/.")
    candidate <- parent
  }
}
PROJECT_ROOT <- find_project_root()

project_file <- function(relative_path, area, must_exist = TRUE) {
  # Exact project-relative paths only; no first-file search or OS-root /data path.
  parts <- strsplit(relative_path, "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (grepl("^(/|~|[A-Za-z]:)", relative_path) || ".." %in% parts ||
      grepl("<", relative_path, fixed = TRUE) ||
      !startsWith(relative_path, paste0("data/", area, "/"))) {
    stop("Replace the placeholder with an exact path inside data/", area, "/: ", relative_path)
  }
  path <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, relative_path)
  if (must_exist && (!file.exists(path) || dir.exists(path))) stop("Input file not found: ", path)
  # Resolve existing ancestors to reject a path that leaves the project via a symlink.
  ancestor <- path
  while (!file.exists(ancestor)) ancestor <- dirname(ancestor)
  resolved <- normalizePath(ancestor, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  allowed <- normalizePath(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data", area), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  if (!startsWith(allowed, paste0(PROJECT_ROOT, "/"))) {
    stop("data/", area, "/ resolves outside the project root.")
  }
  if (!identical(resolved, allowed) && !startsWith(resolved, paste0(allowed, "/"))) {
    stop("Resolved path leaves data/", area, "/: ", relative_path)
  }
  path
}

sha256_file <- function(path) {
  if (!requireNamespace("digest", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Cannot verify input identity: digest is unavailable. Use an available SHA-256 implementation before loading data.")
  }
  digest::digest(file = path, algo = "sha256", serialize = FALSE)
}

verify_input_sha256 <- function(path, expected) {
  # Bind this run to the exact file inspected when the notebook was prepared.
  if (!is.character(expected) || length(expected) != 1L || is.na(expected) ||
      !grepl("^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$", expected)) {
    stop("Fill the expected SHA-256 from the inspected input before loading data.")
  }
  actual <- sha256_file(path)
  if (!identical(actual, tolower(expected))) stop("Input changed: identify the new version before loading ", basename(path), ".")
  actual
}
```

## 綁定輸入檔

```{r}
INPUTS <- c(
  rental_in_field = "data/processed/youbike_rental_in_field_2024.parquet",
  youbike_weather_hourly = "data/processed/youbike_weather_hourly_2024.parquet"
)
EXPECTED_INPUT_SHA256 <- c(
  rental_in_field = "ef6160f4c50aa0b951419304f29a6eb572b65b6027cf027b0d2b107525981e4e",
  youbike_weather_hourly = "c09ab33c7fe724c6479f4cfab3c7933403b045c64b6ecb5e8c29d1b3c52678fe"
)
OUTPUTS <- c(
  calendar = "data/processed/calendar_2024.csv",
  youbike_flow_hourly = "data/processed/youbike_flow_hourly_2024.parquet"
)

input_paths <- vapply(INPUTS, project_file, character(1), area = "processed")
output_paths <- vapply(OUTPUTS, project_file, character(1), area = "processed", must_exist = FALSE)
stopifnot(!any(output_paths %in% input_paths))
if (any(file.exists(output_paths))) stop("Review existing outputs before replacing them.")

input_fingerprints <- map_chr(names(input_paths), \(key) {
  verify_input_sha256(input_paths[[key]], EXPECTED_INPUT_SHA256[[key]])
}) |>
  set_names(names(input_paths))

rental_in_field <- read_parquet(input_paths[["rental_in_field"]])
youbike_weather_hourly <- read_parquet(input_paths[["youbike_weather_hourly"]])

stopifnot(
  nrow(rental_in_field) == 8112511L,
  !anyDuplicated(select(rental_in_field, StationUID, SrcUpdateTime)),
  nrow(youbike_weather_hourly) == 86L * 8784L,
  !anyDuplicated(select(youbike_weather_hourly, StationUID, datetime)),
  identical(attr(youbike_weather_hourly$datetime, "tzone"), "Asia/Taipei"),
  identical(attr(rental_in_field$SrcUpdateTime, "tzone"), "Asia/Taipei")
)
```

## 日曆表

```{r}
# Weekday days off in 2024 (DGPA 113 calendar) and Taipei typhoon days, as confirmed by the team.
DAYS_OFF <- tribble(
  ~date, ~day_off_reason,
  "2024-01-01", "開國紀念日",
  "2024-02-08", "春節",
  "2024-02-09", "春節",
  "2024-02-12", "春節",
  "2024-02-13", "春節",
  "2024-02-14", "春節",
  "2024-02-28", "和平紀念日",
  "2024-04-04", "兒童節及清明節",
  "2024-04-05", "兒童節及清明節",
  "2024-05-01", "勞動節",
  "2024-06-10", "端午節",
  "2024-07-24", "颱風假（凱米）",
  "2024-07-25", "颱風假（凱米）",
  "2024-09-17", "中秋節",
  "2024-10-02", "颱風假（山陀兒）",
  "2024-10-03", "颱風假（山陀兒）",
  "2024-10-04", "颱風假（山陀兒）",
  "2024-10-10", "國慶日",
  "2024-10-31", "颱風假（康芮）"
) |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))
MAKEUP_WORKDAYS <- tibble(date = as.Date("2024-02-17"), day_off_reason = "補班")
SEMESTERS <- tribble(
  ~term, ~start, ~end,
  "112-2", "2024-02-19", "2024-06-09",
  "113-1", "2024-09-02", "2024-12-20"
) |>
  mutate(across(c(start, end), as.Date))

stopifnot(
  all(wday(DAYS_OFF$date, week_start = 1) <= 5),
  all(wday(MAKEUP_WORKDAYS$date, week_start = 1) >= 6)
)

calendar <- tibble(date = seq(as.Date("2024-01-01"), as.Date("2024-12-31"), by = "day")) |>
  left_join(bind_rows(DAYS_OFF, MAKEUP_WORKDAYS), join_by(date), relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  mutate(
    day_of_week = wday(date, week_start = 1),
    weekday = as.integer(
      date %in% MAKEUP_WORKDAYS$date |
        (day_of_week <= 5 & !date %in% DAYS_OFF$date)
    ),
    semester = as.integer(map_lgl(date, \(day) any(day >= SEMESTERS$start & day <= SEMESTERS$end)))
  ) |>
  select(date, day_of_week, weekday, semester, day_off_reason)

stopifnot(
  nrow(calendar) == 366L,
  !anyDuplicated(calendar$date),
  all(calendar$weekday %in% 0:1),
  all(calendar$semester %in% 0:1)
)

calendar |>
  count(weekday, semester)
calendar |>
  filter(!is.na(day_off_reason))
```

## 由分鐘級更新計算每小時借還與調度

```{r}
DISPATCH_STEP <- 10

# One step = change in rentable bikes from the previous update of the same station.
# A step belongs to period (t - 1h, t] when its update time falls in that interval.
steps <- rental_in_field |>
  select(StationUID, SrcUpdateTime, AvailableRentBikes) |>
  arrange(StationUID, SrcUpdateTime) |>
  mutate(
    step = AvailableRentBikes - lag(AvailableRentBikes),
    gap_min = as.numeric(SrcUpdateTime - lag(SrcUpdateTime), units = "mins"),
    .by = StationUID
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(step)) |>
  mutate(datetime = ceiling_date(SrcUpdateTime, "hour", change_on_boundary = FALSE))

# Distribution used to set the dispatch threshold.
steps |>
  summarise(
    steps = n(),
    median_gap_min = median(gap_min),
    p999_abs_step = quantile(abs(step), 0.999),
    share_abs_step_ge_10 = mean(abs(step) >= DISPATCH_STEP),
    share_abs_step_ge_20 = mean(abs(step) >= 20)
  )

hourly_steps <- steps |>
  summarise(
    n_updates = n(),
    step_sum = sum(step),
    rider_return = sum(step[step > 0 & step < DISPATCH_STEP]),
    rider_rent = -sum(step[step < 0 & step > -DISPATCH_STEP]),
    dispatch_in = sum(step[step >= DISPATCH_STEP]),
    dispatch_out = -sum(step[step <= -DISPATCH_STEP]),
    max_step = max(abs(step)),
    .by = c(StationUID, datetime)
  )
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(select(hourly_steps, StationUID, datetime)))
```

## 合併到站點 × 整點 panel

```{r}
flow_columns <- c("n_updates", "rider_return", "rider_rent", "dispatch_in", "dispatch_out", "max_step")

youbike_flow_hourly <- youbike_weather_hourly |>
  arrange(StationUID, datetime) |>
  mutate(
    prev_ServiceStatus = lag(ServiceStatus),
    net_flow = AvailableRentBikes - lag(AvailableRentBikes),
    .by = StationUID
  ) |>
  left_join(hourly_steps, join_by(StationUID, datetime), relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  mutate(
    # Hours without any update but with two valid snapshots had no change.
    across(all_of(c(flow_columns, "step_sum")), \(value) if_else(!is.na(net_flow) & is.na(value), 0, value)),
    across(all_of(c(flow_columns, "step_sum")), \(value) if_else(is.na(net_flow), NA, value)),
    rider_net_flow = rider_return - rider_rent,
    period_date = as_date(datetime - hours(1)),
    hour_of_day = hour(datetime - hours(1))
  ) |>
  left_join(select(calendar, date, weekday, semester), join_by(period_date == date), relationship = "many-to-one", unmatched = "drop")

stopifnot(
  nrow(youbike_flow_hourly) == 86L * 8784L,
  !anyDuplicated(select(youbike_flow_hourly, StationUID, datetime)),
  # Steps inside (t - 1h, t] add up to the difference between the two snapshots.
  with(youbike_flow_hourly, all(is.na(net_flow) | step_sum == net_flow)),
  with(youbike_flow_hourly, all(is.na(net_flow) | rider_net_flow + dispatch_in - dispatch_out == net_flow)),
  # Only the 2024-01-01 00:00 rows describe a 2023 period; they have no flow either.
  with(youbike_flow_hourly, all(!is.na(weekday) | (period_date < as.Date("2024-01-01") & is.na(net_flow))))
)

youbike_flow_hourly <- youbike_flow_hourly |>
  mutate(across(all_of(flow_columns), as.integer)) |>
  select(
    StationUID, datetime, period_date, hour_of_day, weekday, semester,
    ServiceStatus, prev_ServiceStatus, AvailableRentBikes, AvailableReturnBikes, GeneralBikes, ElectricBikes,
    status_time, status_age_min, status_missing_reason,
    net_flow, rider_net_flow, rider_return, rider_rent, dispatch_in, dispatch_out, n_updates, max_step,
    Temp, HUMD, D24R, D24R_trace, rain
  )

glimpse(youbike_flow_hourly)
colSums(is.na(youbike_flow_hourly))
```

```{r}
# Values to note for downstream analysis (normal service at both snapshots).
flow_valid <- youbike_flow_hourly |>
  filter(ServiceStatus == "正常營運", prev_ServiceStatus == "正常營運", !is.na(net_flow))

flow_valid |>
  summarise(
    station_hours = n(),
    hours_with_dispatch = sum(dispatch_in + dispatch_out > 0),
    dispatch_bikes = sum(dispatch_in + dispatch_out),
    rider_bikes = sum(rider_return + rider_rent),
    hours_abs_net_ge_25 = sum(abs(net_flow) >= 25),
    hours_abs_net_ge_25_with_dispatch = sum(abs(net_flow) >= 25 & dispatch_in + dispatch_out > 0)
  )

# Hours whose net change came mostly from dispatch, by station.
flow_valid |>
  summarise(
    hours_with_dispatch = sum(dispatch_in + dispatch_out > 0),
    dispatch_bikes = sum(dispatch_in + dispatch_out),
    .by = StationUID
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(dispatch_bikes)) |>
  head(10)
```

## 寫出與讀回驗證

```{r}
outputs <- list(calendar = calendar, youbike_flow_hourly = youbike_flow_hourly)
stopifnot(setequal(names(outputs), names(OUTPUTS)))

verification <- list()
for (key in names(outputs)) {
  path <- output_paths[[key]]
  if (file.exists(path)) stop("Output already exists; review it before replacing: ", path)
  frame <- outputs[[key]]
  if (key == "calendar") {
    write_csv(frame, path, na = "")
    reread <- read_csv(
      path,
      col_types = cols(date = col_date(), day_of_week = "i", weekday = "i", semester = "i", day_off_reason = "c"),
      na = ""
    )
  } else {
    write_parquet(frame, path, compression = "zstd")
    reread <- read_parquet(path)
    stopifnot(identical(attr(reread$datetime, "tzone"), "Asia/Taipei"))
  }
  stopifnot(
    identical(names(reread), names(frame)),
    nrow(reread) == nrow(frame),
    isTRUE(all.equal(as.data.frame(frame), as.data.frame(reread), check.attributes = FALSE))
  )
  verification[[key]] <- list(
    data_path = OUTPUTS[[key]],
    rows = nrow(reread),
    columns = ncol(reread),
    size_mb = round(file.size(path) / 1e6, 2),
    sha256 = sha256_file(path),
    status = "read-back checks passed"
  )
  print(verification[[key]])
}

# Inputs must be unchanged after processing.
for (key in names(input_paths)) {
  stopifnot(identical(sha256_file(input_paths[[key]]), input_fingerprints[[key]]))
}
```

## 執行結果

2026-10-18 以乾淨 R 程序（`Rscript --vanilla`，`knitr::knit()` 輸出至暫存位置）完整執行。以下為該次實際輸出：

- 輸入核對：兩個輸入檔的 SHA-256 皆與預期一致，執行後未改變。
- 日曆：366 天；上班日 244 天（其中上課學期 150 天）、非上班日 122 天；學期內 222 天。非週末休假日 19 天（含颱風假 6 天）、補班日 1 天（2024-02-17）。
- 步：8,112,425 個；相鄰更新間隔中位數 1.9 分鐘；單步 |變化| 99.9% 分位數 9 輛，≥ 10 輛的步占 0.082%、≥ 20 輛占 0.0082%。
- 合併：755,424 列 × 28 欄，(`StationUID`, `datetime`) 不重複；所有兩個快照都可用的站時，步的加總都等於 `net_flow`，`rider_net_flow` + `dispatch_in` − `dispatch_out` 也都等於 `net_flow`。流量欄位缺 64,593 站時（與上游快照缺值一致）；`weekday`／`semester` 只在 2024-01-01 00:00 的 86 列（描述 2023-12-31 23 時）為 `NA`。
- 兩個整點皆「正常營運」的 684,702 站時中：5,537 站時含調度步，調度共 85,975 輛次，占全部 |淨流量| 的 3.5%；其中 364 站時同一小時既有 ≥ 10 的增加也有 ≥ 10 的減少（可能是調度，也可能是資料短暫跳動）。含調度的站時最多在 12 時、15–18 時。調度量最多的站為 `TPE500101022`（20,385 輛次）與 `TPE500101181`（11,968 輛次），即捷運公館站 2、3 號出口。
- 原本 |淨流量| ≥ 25 的 7,193 站時中只有 1,330 個（18%）含調度步；扣除調度後仍有 6,649 站時 |騎乘淨流量| ≥ 25，支持「這些大幅變化多數是真實尖峰需求」。
